raw: “I remember a public shower with this foul puddle around the drain. There was a clump of hair stretched across it, and gray suds were pooling around my sandals. The hair caught my eye first, but then I looked down at what my feet were sitting in. Sandals are supposed to keep you off the shower floor, but they don’t seem like much protection when that water is all around them. I kept thinking about what might be mixed into it. Just looking at that hair and the gray water made me feel disgusted.”
